notes:
E-Sys MAX 5.5.1

- Toolbar: drag a button along the toolbar to move it (the order is kept), drag it off the toolbar to unpin it, or drag a tool from the E-Sys MAX menu onto the toolbar to pin it there.
- Unpinning a toolbar button now asks first, so it is not done by mistake.
- The E-Sys MAX menu is sorted into groups (Read the car, Code and flash, Backup and recovery, Learn) with small headings and icons; a tool on the toolbar is not listed twice.
- After a full backup the SVT on the Coding page looks like a fresh read again: every module folded, nothing selected.
- The battery badge shows the voltage again right after E-Sys connects to an F10 (one-connection gateway), instead of "KL30 --" for up to 20 seconds.
- Car-writing tools load after several updates in one day (the toolbar was empty until the next day).
- Everything from 5.5.0: MAX Practice with 41 lessons, Open Connection checks the right car series, stronger protection.
